# Night Docket

Night Docket is an independent publication about AI agents for law firms. It explains, in plain language, how law firms can put AI agents to work on real firm objects: demand letters, contract review, client intake, the morning brief. Pages carry a named human author, a facts-checked date, and samples produced on synthetic matters, never on real client data. Night Docket is not affiliated with any software vendor it writes about, and nothing on the site is legal advice.

## Key hubs

- https://nightdocket.com/videos/ : every published build, written step by step
